reports.title: Destination: East Tennessee’s Hidden Treasures
reports.text:
Capt. Richard Simms and his grandson, Charlie, were both obviously pleased with this 2.5-pound crappie pulled from Chickamauga Lake on the Tennessee River last spring while long-line trolling. (Photo: Priscilla Simms-Roberson)
Unlike some Southern reservoirs where spider-rigging dominates the crappie scene, you will not find large numbers of anglers using that technique on Chickamauga Lake. Instead, fishermen rely on a variety of other proven tactics throughout the year.
During late winter and early spring, many anglers long-line troll creeks and embayments as crappie move into their prespawn patterns. After the spawn, fishermen often move offshore, using modern electronics such as…
